description: Get basic information about a Compute Engine Commitment, including its name, ID, status, plan, type, resources, and creation, start and end timestamps. Requires project, region, and commitment name as input.

inputSchema.description: Request message for getting a region commitment.

name.description: Required. Identifier. Name of the commitment to return.

project.description: Required. Project ID for this request.

region.description: Required. The region of the commitment.

name: get_commitment_basic_info

ResourceCommitment.description: Commitment for a particular hardware resource (a commitment is composed of one or more of these).

acceleratorType.description: Name of the accelerator type or GPU resource. Specify this field only when the type of hardware resource is ACCELERATOR.

amount.description: The quantity of the hardware resource that you want to commit to purchasing (in a type-dependent unit). - For vCPUs, you must specify an integer value. - For memory, you specify the amount of MB that you want. The value you specify must be a multiple of 256 MB, with up to 6.5 GB of memory per every vCPU. - For GPUs, you must specify an integer value. - For Local SSD disks, you must specify the amount in GB. The size of a single Local SSD disk is 375 GB.

type.description: The type of hardware resource that you want to specify. You can specify any of the following values: - VCPU - MEMORY - LOCAL_SSD - ACCELERATOR Specify as a separate entry in the list for each individual resource type.

id.description: The unique identifier for the commitment.

resources.description: A list of all the hardware resources of the commitment.
